resources.string: Weekly awake periods and watch sleep reminders

Uses the watch’s live sleep detection while worn and not charging. Two or more fresh reports must confirm sleep for the selected duration. Keep the phone connected; unknown or stale data never triggers a reminder. Detection may be delayed by the watch.
No awake periods. Add the times when you want to stay awake.

Confirmed sleep triggers a native watch reminder again at the selected repeat interval. Ringing reuses one local one-shot alarm, scheduled for the next whole minute (up to 60 seconds later); it uses the watch’s preset ringtone. Close the reminder on the watch. The app does not time out or delete it and does not need a close receipt. Ringing periods take priority when periods overlap.
Uses native watch alarm vibration. Close the reminder on the watch.
Native watch alarm sent. Check the vibration on your wrist.
Could not start the native alarm. Check the watch connection and retry.
Enter a name, select at least one day, use different start and end times, and enter minutes within the displayed ranges.
Saved rules cannot be read. Monitoring is paused; the original rules have been preserved.
Up to 32 awake periods are supported.
Waiting for fresh sleep and wearing data
Native watch alarm sent; no ringtone is played.
Another alarm is using the watch. Try again after it stops.
Schedules the watch’s preset alarm for the next whole minute; reuses one alarm.
Native watch alarm updated. It rings at the next whole minute; close it on the watch.
No free watch alarm slot. Remove an unused alarm on the watch before trying again.
The watch did not confirm the alarm update. Check the connection and retry.
